a: शिंबी — 1 A pod, legume. --2 A kind of plant.
शिंबः — A kind of large shrub (चकमर्द). --बा A pod, legume; (also शिंबिः f. in this sense); Māl. 9. 7.
शिंबिका — 1 A pod, legume. --2 A kind of kidney-bean.
शिंज् — {c1c} {c2c} A., {c10c} U. (शिंजते, शिंक्ते, शिंजयति-ते, शिंजित) 1 To tinkle, jingle, rattle; Śi. 10. 62. --2 To roar, sound, bellow.
शिंजः — Tinkle, jingle, tinkling or jingling sound; especially of ornaments such as anklets.
शिंजंजिका — A chain worn round the loins.
शिंजिनी — 1 A bow-string. --2 An anklet (worn round the feet).
शिंजित — p. p. Tinkling, jingling. --तं 1 Tinkling, jingling (of anklets &c.); कूजितं राजहंसानां नेदं नूपुरशिंजितं V. 4. 14. --2 Clanking (of chains).
